checkedAlternates.risk: Timed Out is a rare procedural dismissal.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Timed Out occurs before facing a ball due to arrival delay (group-1), not during active ball play (group-2).

checkedAlternates.risk: Stumped occurs off a bowler’s delivery.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Stumped requires the batter stepping out of the popping crease while the wicketkeeper breaks the stumps (group-3).
